page.notes: Marginal notes on the left are in Greek or Hebrew letters (or a similar non-Latin script) and are too faint to read; they are marked as illegible. Their reference marks are not visible in the text. Doubtful readings: "eia" (first word after "Lutheranorum"), "existimē", "cupidam", and "effet" (kept as printed). Italic/roman switching in "Belloiocius ... cum ecce", "At illa ... viderim:" is uncertain; these are set roman. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with printed hyphens.
